scope: Post-hoc descriptive association of previously fixed unlabeled image/text features with observed Pixel t045 K on the same DEV images; existing mixed score/answer records parsed only for identity and K
statistics: Per-task Spearman correlation with observed K and rank AUC for K<=64 vs >64 when each class has >=2 examples; larger feature predicts K<=64, do not select direction as confirmed. Report all n and null unsupported cases.
limitations: Exploratory same DEV after seeing score/K strata; associations do not establish causal or predictive generalization
K<=64 is the post-hoc diagnostic bin, not a predetermined production threshold
AUC uses a same-sample descriptive target and does not assess a deployment rule, threshold, latency or downstream score
No new GT, generation, model or GPU
